# M21-S1: logos lsp reports a missing gopls and exits non-zero, writing
# nothing on stdout (stdout carries only protocol messages). The script does
# not need gopls, so it runs whether or not the gate of logos_lsp.txt can.

# The command is part of logos mode only.
logos help lsp
stdout 'Lsp runs a Language Server Protocol server'
! go help lsp
stderr 'unknown help topic'

mkdir $WORK/empty
env PATH=$WORK/empty
! logos lsp
stderr '^logos lsp: gopls not found on PATH$'
! stdout .

# Arguments are refused before anything starts.
! logos lsp extra
stderr '^logos lsp: unexpected argument "extra"$'
